resolved.title: LIKE 模糊查询
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The Like Operator[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]LIKE [/b]keyword is useful when specifying a [b]search condition[/b] within your WHERE clause.[code format="sql" ]SELECT column_name(s)
FROM table_name
WHERE column_name [b]LIKE pattern[/b];[/code]
SQL [b]pattern [/b]matching enables you to use "_" to match any single character and "%" to match an arbitrary number of characters (including zero characters).

For example, to select employees whose [i]FirstNames [/i]begin with the letter [b]A[/b], you would use the following query:[code format="sql" codeId="3059"]SELECT * FROM employees 
WHERE FirstName [b]LIKE 'A%'[/b];[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2827" width="100%"]
As another example, the following SQL query selects all employees with a [i]LastName [/i]ending with the letter "s":[code format="sql" codeId="3060"]SELECT * FROM employees 
WHERE LastName [b]LIKE '%s'[/b];[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2828" width="100%"]
[note]The % wildcard can be used [b]multiple[/b] times within the same pattern.[/note]

content.text: 当**WHERE**需要模糊搜索查询时，**LIKE**关键字则很有用：
content.text_html:
The **LIKE **keyword is useful when specifying a search condition within your WHERE clause.

当在WHERE子句中指定一个搜索条件时，LIKE **关键字很有用。

content.text:
SQL **模式**(pattern) 常用的两个符号：
- `_`: 匹配任何单个字符
- `%`: 来匹配任意数量的字符（包括零字符）。

例如，要查询名字**FirstName**以字母**A**开头的员工，则可以使用以下查询:
content.text_html:
SQL **pattern **matching enables you to use "_" to match any single character and "%" to match an arbitrary number of characters (including zero characters).

For example, to select employees whose *FirstNames *begin with the letter A, you would use the following query:

SQL 模式匹配使你能够使用"_"来匹配任何单个字符，"%"来匹配任意数量的字符（包括零字符）。

例如，要选择那些名字以字母A开头的员工，你可以使用以下查询。

content.content:
SELECT * FROM employees 
WHERE FirstName LIKE 'A%';

resolved.title: 巧克力甜点
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你在一家餐厅吃饭，决定点一份巧克力甜点。
下面是甜点表**desserts**：

![](/content/assets/43cd0411fe82e811af4f.jpeg)

写一个查询，只输出有关**巧克力**的甜点。

注意当列`name`中 包含 **Chocolate** 则为巧克力甜点
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]LIKE[/h1][/s0l0!-header]
You are having dinner at a restaurant and decide to order a chocolate dessert.
Here is the [b]desserts[/b] menu: [img id="4508" width="100%"]
Write a query to output only [b]chocolate[/b] desserts.
[note]Use the [b]LIKE[/b] operator, and don't forget about "%".[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 使用**LIKE**操作符，并且不要忘记"%"。

code_templates.solution_code:
SELECT * FROM desserts 
WHERE name LIKE '%Chocolate%'

resolved.title: MIN 最小值函数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The MIN Function[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]MIN [/b]function is used to return the minimum value of an expression in a SELECT statement.

For example, you might wish to know the minimum salary among the employees. [code format="sql" codeId="3061"]SELECT [b]MIN[/b](Salary) AS Salary FROM employees;[/code]
[img id="2829" width="100%"]
[note]All of the SQL functions can be combined together to create a single expression.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The MIN Function[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]MIN [/b]function is used to return the minimum value of an expression in a SELECT statement.

For example, you might wish to know the minimum salary among the employees. [code format="sql" codeId="3061"]SELECT [b]MIN[/b](Salary) AS Salary FROM employees;[/code]
[img id="2829" width="100%"]
[note]All of the SQL functions can be combined together to create a single expression.[/note]

content.text:
**MIN**函数用于返回SELECT语句中表达式的最小值。

例如，你可能希望知道雇员中的最低工资：
content.text_html:
The **MIN **function is used to return the minimum value of an expression in a SELECT statement.

For example, you might wish to know the minimum salary among the employees.

MIN **函数用于返回SELECT语句中表达式的最小值。

例如，你可能希望知道雇员中的最低工资。

content.content: SELECT MIN(Salary) AS Salary FROM employees;

resolved.question_text:
拖拽选项，从物品表**items**中查询列`name`和成本`cost`的最小值，并按名字`name`和卖家ID `seller_id`进行过滤。


```sql_typein
SELECT name, __0__(cost) 
FROM items WHERE name 
__1__ '%boxes of frogs' AND 
seller_id __2__ (68, 6, 18)
```
resolved.question_text_html:
Drag and drop from the options below to complete the statement, which selects ''name'' and minimum of the "cost'' from ''items'', filtering by name and seller id.
[!raw!]
SELECT name, {0}(cost) 
FROM items WHERE name 
{1} '%boxes of frogs' AND 
seller_id {2} (68, 6, 18)
